data.one_liner: Annotations for generating boilerplate code for Flutter ThemeExtension classes.
data.what_it_does: Provides annotations like @ThemeExtensions and @ThemeGen that work with the theme_extensions_builder package to automatically generate code for Flutter theme extensions. It handles things like lerping, copyWith, and context accessors.
use_when: You are using theme_extensions_builder to create custom Flutter theme extensions.
You want to automatically generate boilerplate like copyWith and lerp for theme classes.
avoid_when: You prefer writing your ThemeExtension boilerplate manually.
strengths: Reduces boilerplate code for custom Flutter theme extensions.
Provides convenient annotations and field-level exclusions like @ignore.
weaknesses: Does nothing without the theme_extensions_builder package.
Requires build_runner and code generation setup.
data.setup_notes: Add theme_extensions_builder_annotation to dependencies, theme_extensions_builder and build_runner to dev dependencies, and run build_runner.
